September 16, 2023
Claim opened following a rear-end collision at a signalized intersection. The claimant reports a shoulder injury and is
represented by counsel, who has requested that all contact go through their office.
September 26, 2023
Reviewed the policy record and confirmed the driver is named on the policy and the vehicle is listed as an insured
unit. Coverage is in force for the loss period.
December 7, 2023
Police report and two independent witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of impact. Photos
from the scene and the statement from the other driver are consistent with the accident occurring as described.
January 13, 2024
Vehicle inspection shows rear-end daamge consistent with the reported impact. A few older scratches appear on the
bumper cover, and it is not yet clear whether all of the damage came from this collision. Referred to the appraiser for
a closer review.
January 25, 2024
Claimant's account of the accident has remained the same in every conversation so far, including the initial call, the
reocrded statement and the follow-up through counsel. No prior injury to the same body area is known from the
claimant's history or the records requested to date.
March 24, 2024
Medical records received show the reported shoulder injury is plausible for a collision of this type. Treatment followed
a usual course of physical therapy and tapered off as the claimant improved.
April 11, 2024
Sopke with counsel regarding the treatment timeline and the outstanding records request. Counsel confirmed the
claimant's position and agreed to provide the remaining documentation.
April 21, 2024
File reviewed. Liability and coverage are established, and the injury is consistent with the mechanism of loss.
Remaining question is the extent of the vehicle damage attributable to this impact, which is being assessed by the
appraiser.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
